ways.label: Mangahao Road to Poulton Drive car park
ways.time: 6 - 7 hrs going south, 7- 8 hrs going north
evidence: From the parking area on Mangahao Road, the track enters the bush and climbs to a low spur, where an orientation sign is located.
The track ends at the Poulton Drive car park.
400 m past the Tararua Forest Park sign is a small parking area. This is the start of the track.
It is a further 1.9 km along Gladstone Road Poulton Drive junction to the carpark and start of the track.

doubts: No feature or name entry for the Mangahao Road parking area, so the start has no ref. The track can be walked in either direction (times given going south and north); the description runs south from Mangahao Road. Makahika Ridge is not clearly the 'Makahika' peak entry, so left without ref.
